entries.title: Library test: the Mudling (style key look)
entries.prompt:
IMAGE REQUEST: ONE SINGLE ILLUSTRATION. Return exactly one image.

The attached picture is the style key. Paint one new picture in exactly its painting style: the same dense painted texture, fine brushwork, deep saturated colors, warm lamplight and crisp detail.

A MUDLING, a small friendly mud monster, knee high: a rounded lump of brown mud with a puddle base, two stubby mud arms, big round shiny eyes, a small open mouth, and a little green sprout with two leaves on top of its head. It stands on a plain flat magenta background, full body, facing the viewer, a curious friendly look. No other characters, no text.

entries.title: Grace: hero pose (cozy sweats, new style)
entries.prompt:
IMAGE REQUEST: ONE SINGLE ILLUSTRATION. Return exactly one image, nothing else. One character, no grid, no second pose.

WHAT THIS IS
The hero pose of GRACE for "The Adventures of Tom", a family role-playing game: the master reference every other picture of her will copy.

ATTACHED IMAGES (in this order)
1. The STYLE KEY, a finished painting of the family. Match its painting style exactly: the dense jewel-toned painted texture, fine visible brushwork, deep saturated colors, warm light and crisp detail. Match how it draws a child, her head size and her body proportions, as in the key's Grace.
2. The SCHOOL YARD PAINTING. This is the texture target. Paint Grace with the same dense painted texture on skin, hair and fabric, the same fine visible brushwork and the same crisp dark-edged detail as the foliage and brick.
3. A HEIGHT CHART of grey shapes. It shows SIZE ONLY. Do not copy the grey shapes, the grid or the text. Use it to check that Grace is a 9 year old, 4 feet 2 inches tall.
4. GRACE's older reference picture. Use it for her FACE, hair and the yellow squishy keychain ONLY. Her outfit there is old, see GRACE'S OUTFIT. Do not copy how it is rendered: it is smooth and glossy, and the new picture must be painted like attachment 1. The magenta background in the attachments is not part of the picture.

STYLE RULE (the most important instruction)
Attachment 4 is for LIKENESS ONLY. Do NOT copy how it is rendered: it is smooth and glossy, and the final picture must NOT be. Repaint Grace from scratch in the painting style of attachments 1 and 2, as if the same artist painted her in the same sitting: dense painted texture on skin, hair and clothing, visible brushstrokes, crisp dark-edged detail on fabric folds, hair strands and shoe edges, deep saturated colors and rich contrast. No airbrushed skin, no smooth gradients, no glossy plastic look, no soft-focus photo look, no 3D render look. The sweatshirt and sweatpants show a knitted, fuzzy fabric texture.

THE POSE
Full body, head to feet fully in frame, standing neutral and relaxed, body turned a little (three quarter) toward the viewer, a warm natural smile, face clear and readable, hands empty and relaxed at her sides, both feet flat on the ground and fully visible. Large and centered, filling most of the height of the image, with a little space above her head and below her feet. This is the most detailed picture of the set: individual hair strands, skin, fabric weave, glitter on the shoes.

GRACE
A 9 year old girl, real height 4 feet 2 inches. Bright, confident and a little bossy: a playful, self-assured smile.

GRACE'S OUTFIT
Loose, comfy, cozy sweats: an oversized soft lavender sweatshirt with sleeves a little too long and a relaxed fit, and baggy heather-gray sweatpants, slightly bunched at the ankles. Cute glittery sneakers in pink and silver glitter with white soles and bright laces. Her yellow squishy keychain clipped at her hip on the sweatpants waistband, exactly as in attachment 4. No leotard, no gym outfit.

ART STYLE
- A whimsical storybook illustration of a real person, shown full body, painted by hand in a rich, dense, jewel-toned style with visible painted texture and fine, detailed brushwork, like the style key. Gently simplified shapes. Slightly stylized features that keep a clear likeness. Clothing details are drawn clearly.
- Caricature proportions for a child: a clearly oversized head, one quarter of her full height from the top of her hair to her chin, noticeably bigger than a real child's, a small slim body, small hands and small feet, large expressive eyes and a warm, slightly exaggerated expression. The head is as large relative to her body as the style key's Grace, a caricature, not a realistic child. The face keeps a clear likeness of the real child in attachment 4.
- Warm golden light from the upper left, a soft warm glow, a gentle rim light, deep saturated colors with rich contrast and fine surface texture.
- Clean, crisp edges with fine detail. No thick or black outlines.
- NOT pixel art, NOT retro game art, NOT photorealistic, NOT a 3D render, NOT anime, NOT flat cartoon shading. No pixelation, no dithering, no limited color palette.

LIKENESS
Keep the face of attachment 4: the exact face shape, cheeks, nose, lips, smile, eyebrows, eye shape and color, skin tone and the hair color, length, parting, volume and texture. Exaggerate only the head size and the expression, never the individual features. Do not beautify, age up or age down her, and do not turn her into a generic child.

BACKGROUND
One flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF filling the whole image. No magenta anywhere on the character. No magenta glow, spill, tint or fringe on her edges or hair strands. No ground, no shadow, no gradient, no border, no text, no labels.

NEVER substitute. Draw only Grace. Family friendly for ages 6 and up. If anything is unclear, draw her standing relaxed and smiling as described.

entries.title: Grace: hero pose step 1, painted in the school yard
entries.prompt:
IMAGE REQUEST: ONE SINGLE ILLUSTRATION. Return exactly one image, nothing else.

WHAT THIS IS
A painting of GRACE standing alone in the school yard, for "The Adventures of Tom", a family role-playing game. She is painted INSIDE the school yard scene, in the same sitting by the same artist, so that she has exactly the same painted texture as the scene around her.

ATTACHED IMAGES (in this order)
1. The school yard painting. This is the BACKGROUND and the STYLE TO MATCH. Keep the school building, paths, signs, lamps, parking area and playground exactly as painted, same framing, nothing removed. Match its dense, jewel-toned painted texture, its fine visible brushwork, its deep saturated colors, its warm lamplight and its level of detail in the character.
2. GRACE's older reference picture. Use it for her FACE, hair and the yellow squishy keychain ONLY. Her outfit there is old, see GRACE'S OUTFIT. Do not copy how it is rendered: it is smooth and glossy, and the new picture must not be.
3. The STYLE KEY, a finished painting of the family in this same school yard. Match how it paints people and how it draws a child, including Grace's head size and body proportions.
4. A HEIGHT CHART of grey shapes. It shows SIZE ONLY. Do not copy the grey shapes, the grid or the text. Use it to check that Grace is a 9 year old, 4 feet 2 inches tall.
The magenta background in attachment 2 is not part of the picture. Ignore it.

STYLE RULE (the most important instruction)
Attachment 2 is for LIKENESS ONLY. Repaint Grace from scratch in the exact painting style of attachment 1, as if the same artist painted the whole canvas in one sitting: the same dense painted texture on skin, hair and fabric, the same fine visible brushwork, the same crisp dark-edged detail on fabric folds, hair strands and shoe edges, the same deep saturated colors and rich contrast, the same fine detail as the foliage and brick. No airbrushed skin, no smooth gradients, no glossy plastic look, no soft-focus photo look, no 3D render look. Her face keeps the likeness but is painted with the same brushwork as the rest of the picture. The sweatshirt and sweatpants show a knitted, fuzzy fabric texture.

THE SCENE
Use the school yard painting as the whole background. Grace is the only person in the picture. She stands large and centered on the wide paved walkway in the middle of the picture, full body from the top of her hair to the soles of her sneakers, her feet on the paving. She stands neutral and relaxed, body turned a little (three quarter) toward the viewer, a warm natural smile, face clear and readable, hands empty and relaxed at her sides, both feet flat and fully visible. She is big in the frame, so that her face, hair strands, fabric weave and shoe glitter can be seen in fine detail, while the school yard stays recognizable behind her. She casts a soft shadow on the paving.

GRACE
A 9 year old girl, real height 4 feet 2 inches. Bright, confident and a little bossy: a playful, self-assured smile.

GRACE'S OUTFIT (overrides her reference picture's clothes)
Loose, comfy, cozy sweats: an oversized soft lavender sweatshirt with sleeves a little too long and a relaxed fit, and baggy heather-gray sweatpants, slightly bunched at the ankles. Cute glittery sneakers in pink and silver glitter with white soles and bright laces. Her yellow squishy keychain clipped at her hip on the sweatpants waistband, exactly as in attachment 2. No leotard, no gym outfit.

ART STYLE
- A whimsical storybook illustration of a real person, painted by hand in a rich, dense, jewel-toned style with visible painted texture and fine, detailed brushwork, like the school yard painting. Gently simplified shapes. Slightly stylized features that keep a clear likeness.
- Caricature proportions for a child: a clearly oversized head, about one quarter of her full height from the top of her hair to her chin, as large relative to her body as the style key's Grace, a small slim body, small hands and small feet, large expressive eyes and a warm, slightly exaggerated expression.
- She is lit by the SAME light as the background: warm orange lamplight from the nearby lamp posts and the school windows, cool blue-violet dusk sky light as fill, with warm rim light on hair and shoulders.
- Clean, crisp edges with fine detail. No thick or black outlines.
- NOT pixel art, NOT retro game art, NOT photorealistic, NOT a 3D render, NOT anime, NOT flat cartoon shading. No pixelation, no dithering, no limited color palette.

LIKENESS
Keep the face of attachment 2: the exact face shape, cheeks, nose, lips, smile, eyebrows, eye shape and color, skin tone and the hair color, length, parting, volume and texture. Exaggerate only the head size and the expression, never the individual features. Do not beautify, age up or age down her.

NEVER substitute. Draw only Grace. No other people, no text, no labels, no captions, no speech balloons. Family friendly for ages 6 and up. If anything is unclear, draw her standing relaxed and smiling in the school yard as described.

entries.title: Grace: hero pose step 2, cut out on magenta (needs step 1 approved)
entries.prompt:
IMAGE REQUEST: ONE SINGLE EDIT. Return exactly one image, nothing else.

The attached picture is a finished painting of a girl standing in a school yard. Keep the girl EXACTLY as painted: do not redraw, repaint, restyle, sharpen or smooth anything about her. Keep her face, hair strands, sweatshirt, sweatpants, glittery sneakers, yellow keychain, pose, size, position, colors, lighting and the visible painted brushwork and texture on her exactly as they are, pixel for pixel in feel.

Change ONLY the background: replace everything that is not the girl (the school, the paving, the sky, the lamps, the planters, every shadow on the ground) with one flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF filling the whole rest of the image. No ground, no shadow, no gradient, no border, no text, no labels.

No magenta on the girl. No magenta glow, spill, tint or fringe on her edges or hair strands. Keep her edges clean and crisp. Draw nothing new and no one else.
